selection_criteria.best_binary_rf: Highest holdout F1 among Random Forest binary detectors.
selection_criteria.best_binary_xgboost: Highest holdout F1 and lowest latency among XGBoost binary detectors.
selection_criteria.best_multiclass_rf: Highest macro F1 and rare class recall among RF multiclass classifiers.
selection_criteria.best_multiclass_xgboost: Highest macro F1 and throughput among XGBoost multiclass classifiers.
selection_criteria.best_binary_dqn: Track B1 Binary DQN with lowest mean cost and highest containment on validation.
selection_criteria.best_attack_aware_dqn: Track B2 Attack-Aware DQN with lowest cost on multi-threat attacks.
selection_criteria.best_complete_system: Highest end-to-end containment, lowest cost, and compliant with safety invariants.
selection_criteria.best_live_deployable_system: Best performing model strictly compatible with real-time live streaming (R10 or R4 contract).

best_complete_system.configuration: Attack-Aware RF + Track B2 Attack-Aware DQN + Deterministic Safety Gate
best_complete_system.detection_engine: Random Forest R10 + Multiclass Attack Attribution
